snip.t: Antiphospholipid Syndrome (APS): APS is an autoimmune disorder characterized by the presence of antiphospholipid antibodies, which can lead to blood clots and other complications.
Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) is characterized by recurrent arterial and /or venous thrombosis, fetal loss and thrombocytopenia.
